coverage_rule: Every accepted and watchlist record appears exactly once. No representative-only selection is used.
line_semantics: The first three themes form a research agenda: prediction, intervention/counterfactuals, and a personal digital twin. The fourth is its presentation and interaction entry point, not a fourth clinical stage. Calendar branches do not assert paper ancestry or inevitable technical progress.
family_semantics: Accepted records retain their native family; watchlist records use proposed_family without altering their original metadata or review status.
time_bins: 1980–2009, 2010–2014, then one bin per year from 2015 to the latest record year (at least 2026). Older records expand the first bin instead of being omitted.
archival_selection: milestones.json retains the earlier selected examples and source warnings; it is not the full-map data source.
classification_semantics: One primary theme per record, with cross-theme links and a direct/support/framework/adjacent role. Theme membership is editorial placement, not a claim that an achieved capability or clinical benefit has been demonstrated.

routes.label: Disease prediction
routes.question: What might happen to this person?
routes.summary: Wearable signals, digital measures and models for identifying health states and forecasting risk.

keywords.label: Foundation models
keywords.note: Records explicitly tagged as foundation-model work; pretraining alone does not establish a disease forecast or treatment effect.

routes.boundary: Sensing, recognition and representation learning support prediction. Predictive accuracy alone does not establish treatment benefit.
routes.next_question: Which predictions remain reliable across people, devices and daily life?

routes.label: Intervention & counterfactuals
routes.question: What changes under a different action?
routes.summary: Causal effects, alternative-action simulations and adaptive policies that connect observation to action.

keywords.label: Counterfactuals
keywords.note: Predictive recourse and causal treatment-effect estimates are distinct; consult each record's evidence boundary.

routes.boundary: Model-level what-if explanations, causal effects and intervention trials are different evidence classes. Null and mixed results remain visible.
routes.next_question: Do estimated intervention effects hold outside the model and in prospective studies?

routes.label: Personal digital twin
routes.question: Can we build an evolving model of this person?
routes.summary: Individual dynamics, longitudinal state updates and simulations of possible personal trajectories.

keywords.label: Personalization
keywords.note: Cross-theme enablers: individual adaptation and health interpretation are not implemented dynamic twins.

keywords.label: Dynamic simulation
keywords.note: Includes cross-theme methods. Individual physiological simulation, subpopulation simulation and counterfactual-method enablers remain distinct.

keywords.label: Causal frameworks
keywords.note: Conceptual requirements, not prospective validation of deployed personal twins.

routes.boundary: A personalized predictor is not automatically a digital twin. Conceptual frameworks and subpopulation simulators are not validated whole-person twins.
routes.next_question: Can an individual model stay calibrated over time and simulate unseen actions?

routes.label: Metaverse & mixed reality
routes.question: How can a person see and interact with their twin?
routes.summary: Mixed-reality glasses as a sensing, visualization and interaction entry point to a personal digital twin.

keywords.label: Smart glasses
keywords.note: Curated spatial-perception and body-input enablers, not direct smart-glasses system evidence. The catalog has no complete MR-glasses personal-twin system.

keywords.label: Neural interfaces
keywords.note: EMG and BCI input research; relevance does not establish MR integration or mind-reading.

routes.boundary: The current registry contains adjacent egocentric, neural-interface and XR work, not a complete smart-glasses frontier. A rendered avatar is not itself a digital twin.
routes.next_question: Which capabilities make a personal twin usable through mixed-reality glasses?
